name: InspectorSegmentedControl
label: Inspector segments
description: One-row choice between a few options for inspector panels, as native radios under a sliding selection pill.

props.name: label
props.description: The setting's name, drawn inside the bar on the left. Names the radiogroup.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, drawn left to right in the bar's end.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value (controlled). Leave unset and use `defaultValue` for an uncontrolled set.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting selection for an uncontrolled set.

props.name: name
props.description: The radios' shared `name`, for native form submission. Generated when unset.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Takes the whole set out of use.

props.name: size
props.description: Component size, matching Button: `default` is 40px tall, `compact` 32px.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the newly chosen value.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes, applied to the bar.
